title: ♪ Something Just Like TRuST ♪ *: Toxicity Recognition of Span and Target
benchmark_measurement: Detection of toxic language (including hate speech and negative stereotyping) targeted at religious groups.
findings: In the human-annotated dataset, texts targeting Jewish people were labeled toxic more frequently (66.6%) than those targeting Muslims (55.1%). The performance of models in detecting toxicity varied across these religious groups. For example, in the test set, toxicity detection accuracy for content targeting Jewish people ranged from 76% to 86%, while for content targeting Muslims, it ranged from 66% to 80%, depending on the model.
